description: Cross-harness matrix suite for the monitoring plugin's twelve technology skills (datadog, dynatrace, elk, grafana, nagios, newrelic, opentelemetry, overview, pagerduty, prometheus, splunk, zabbix). Prompts are deliberately neutral (no reference to a skills library or documentation) so the no-skill arm is not tipped off. Every expected answer is traceable to cited content shipped in each skill's SKILL.md as of 2026-08-09. knowledge: 'recent' = fact a bare model plausibly lacks (post-cutoff, niche, or specific numeric detail); 'stable' = long-standing fact a strong bare model may already know.

tasks.prompt: Which TCP port does the Datadog Agent Trace Agent component listen on to receive APM traces from tracing libraries? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/datadog/SKILL.md - Key Reference table lists Trace Agent at port 8126 (HTTP)

tasks.prompt: For Datadog Lambda APM billing, how many function invocations equal one APM host-equivalent? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/datadog/SKILL.md - Common Pitfalls number 3, Lambda functions billed per invocation, 150 invocations = 1 APM host-equivalent

tasks.prompt: In Datadog Unified Service Tagging, which three environment variables get set on every container to enable cross-product correlation? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/datadog/SKILL.md - Unified Service Tagging section lists DD_ENV, DD_SERVICE, DD_VERSION as the reserved correlation tags

tasks.prompt: In Dynatrace full-stack monitoring, how many Host Units does OneAgent consume when monitoring a host with 64 GB of RAM? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/dynatrace/SKILL.md - How to Approach Tasks number 3 and Common Pitfalls number 1, a 64 GB host consumes 8 Host Units in full-stack mode

tasks.prompt: Is the causation logic behind Dynatrace Davis AI problem detection deterministic or based on probabilistic machine learning? Answer in one sentence.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/dynatrace/SKILL.md - Davis AI section states Davis is deterministic, not probabilistic, using the Smartscape dependency graph for causation

tasks.prompt: By default, what is the minimum method timing threshold that Dynatrace PurePath captures as contributing to latency? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/dynatrace/SKILL.md - PurePath section, method timings contributing to latency have a configurable threshold, default 1ms

tasks.prompt: What are the default Elasticsearch disk watermark percentages for the low, high, and flood stages in the Elastic Stack? Answer concisely with all three numbers.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/elk/SKILL.md - Common Pitfalls number 5, default watermarks 85% low, 90% high, 95% flood

tasks.prompt: As of which Elastic Stack version number did ES|QL become generally available? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/elk/SKILL.md - Top 10 Operational Rules number 9, ES|QL has been GA since 8.11

tasks.prompt: In Elastic Stack 9.x, roughly what percentage storage reduction does the Logsdb index mode provide for logs versus standard indexing? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/elk/SKILL.md - Core Expertise bullet and Top 10 Operational Rules number 6, Logsdb provides about 65% storage reduction in 9.x

tasks.prompt: Grafana 12.x shipped a table panel refactor. What performance improvement percentage is cited for it? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/grafana/SKILL.md - 12.x Features bullet list, table refactor (97.8% faster)

tasks.prompt: What is the recommended maximum number of panels to include on a single Grafana dashboard? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/grafana/SKILL.md - Design Rules, target 20-30 panels maximum per dashboard

tasks.prompt: In Grafana alerting, are mute timings recurring and policy-based, or one-time like silences? Answer in one sentence.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/grafana/SKILL.md - Top 10 Operational Rules number 7, mute timings are recurring and policy-based while silences are one-time

tasks.prompt: What TCP port does the NRPE daemon listen on when running on a remote monitored host? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/nagios/SKILL.md - Architecture Overview, NRPE daemon on remote hosts listens on port 5667

tasks.prompt: In a Nagios plugin, which service state does an exit code of 2 represent? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/nagios/SKILL.md - Plugin System Return Codes table, code 2 equals CRITICAL

tasks.prompt: Is Nagios Core free open-source software or a paid per-node commercial product? Answer in one sentence.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/nagios/SKILL.md - intro paragraph and Core vs XI table, Nagios Core is open-source GPL v2 and free while Nagios XI is commercial per-node

tasks.prompt: How many gigabytes per month of data ingest does the New Relic forever-free tier include? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/newrelic/SKILL.md - Pricing Overview table, free tier is 100 GB per month ingest plus 1 Full Platform user, forever free

tasks.prompt: By default, how many days does New Relic retain ingested log data? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/newrelic/SKILL.md - Pricing Overview section, default retention lists Logs 30 days

tasks.prompt: In an NRQL query, if you do not specify a LIMIT clause on a FACET, how many results are returned by default? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/newrelic/SKILL.md - Common Pitfalls number 4, FACET queries default to 10 results

tasks.prompt: What are the default OTLP gRPC and HTTP port numbers used by the OpenTelemetry Collector? Answer concisely with both numbers.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/opentelemetry/SKILL.md - OpenTelemetry Architecture Quick Reference diagram, OTLP gRPC port 4317 and HTTP port 4318

tasks.prompt: Which OpenTelemetry Collector processor should always be configured first in every pipeline to avoid out of memory crashes? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/opentelemetry/SKILL.md - Top 10 Operational Rules number 2 and How to Approach Tasks number 3, memory_limiter must be the first processor

tasks.prompt: When sizing the memory_limiter processor spike_limit_mib setting in the OpenTelemetry Collector, what percentage of limit_mib is recommended? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/opentelemetry/SKILL.md - Top 10 Operational Rules number 2, spike_limit_mib set to 20-25 percent of limit_mib

tasks.prompt: Who is credited with creating the USE method (Utilization, Saturation, Errors) for monitoring system resources? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/overview/SKILL.md - USE Method heading credits Brendan Gregg

tasks.prompt: Who created the RED method (Rate, Errors, Duration) for monitoring services? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/overview/SKILL.md - RED Method heading credits Tom Wilkie

tasks.prompt: Observability spend can reach what percentage of total infrastructure cost, according to general cost guidance? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/overview/SKILL.md - How to Approach Tasks number 4, observability spend can exceed 30 percent of infrastructure cost

tasks.prompt: What is the base API endpoint hostname and path used to send events into PagerDuty through Events API v2? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/pagerduty/SKILL.md - Events API v2 section, endpoint is events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue

tasks.prompt: PagerDuty incident priority levels range from P1 down to which lowest level? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/pagerduty/SKILL.md - Incident Lifecycle section, priority levels P1 Critical through P5 Informational

tasks.prompt: In the PagerDuty Events API v2 payload, which field lets repeated trigger, acknowledge, and resolve calls update the same alert instead of creating duplicates? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/pagerduty/SKILL.md - Events API v2 section, the same dedup_key updates existing alert state; Common Pitfalls number 3 reinforces always setting dedup_key

tasks.prompt: Roughly how much RAM does each active Prometheus time series cost? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/prometheus/SKILL.md - Top 10 Operational Rules number 1, each series costs 3-6 KB RAM

tasks.prompt: How many nodes are recommended when running Alertmanager as a cluster in production? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/prometheus/SKILL.md - Top 10 Operational Rules number 6, run Alertmanager as a cluster of 3 nodes

tasks.prompt: What is the default local TSDB retention period for Prometheus if you do not configure it otherwise? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/prometheus/SKILL.md - Common Pitfalls number 4 and Architecture Quick Reference, default retention is 15 days

tasks.prompt: After how many daily license volume violations within a rolling 30 day window does Splunk disable search on non-internal indexes? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/splunk/SKILL.md - Common Pitfalls number 1, after 5 daily volume violations in a rolling 30-day window Splunk disables search for non-internal indexes

tasks.prompt: What is the default maximum result count for a Splunk subsearch before results are silently truncated? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/splunk/SKILL.md - Common Pitfalls number 5, subsearch default is 10,000 results with a 60 second timeout

tasks.prompt: Using tstats against an accelerated data model in Splunk, roughly how much faster is it compared to a raw search? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/splunk/SKILL.md - Top 10 Cost Rules number 4, accelerated data models enable tstats which is 10-100x faster than raw search

tasks.prompt: Using TimescaleDB compression with Zabbix history tables, what compression ratio should you expect? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/zabbix/SKILL.md - Top 10 Operational Rules number 6 and Common Pitfalls number 1, TimescaleDB compression achieves 5-10x compression on history data

tasks.prompt: What TCP port does the Zabbix agent listen on for passive checks initiated by the server? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/zabbix/SKILL.md - Key Ports table, Agent listens on port 10050 for passive checks from the server

tasks.prompt: Above roughly how many monitored hosts does Zabbix guidance recommend switching to TimescaleDB? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/monitoring/skills/zabbix/SKILL.md - intro paragraph, always recommend TimescaleDB for deployments exceeding 5,000 hosts
